integration_notes: Retains the v2.2 material rates, geometry, stock-selection, productive site-day, Simple overhead and customer-price policies.
v2.3 keeps the live 2m and 3m rafter-length loading points at 0.50 and 1.00, then raises the 4m, 5m and 6m points to 3.75, 6.50 and 7.80.
The rafter-length curve continues to use actual sloped cut length, total installed rafter metres and linear interpolation between points.
Bespoke pricing and non-discountable engineering and building-consent allowances remain unchanged.
Published configurations retain the commercial behavior of their base manifest until a newer manifest is explicitly published.
